## Scope / linked issue / R milestone / PR requirement IDs

## Implementation and evidence

## Tests actually run (and failures)

## Security, tenant isolation and migration impact

## Checkpoints / follow-up (HEAD, remaining work, blockers, next safe step)

- [ ] No secrets or personal data included
- [ ] Contracts, docs, ADRs and requirement traceability updated
- [ ] No claimed success without reproducible evidence
- [ ] Independent review requested

## Implementation Contract IC v1.0

- [ ] Read docs/25-implementation-contract.md; scope, dependencies and ownership recorded (Rxx.yy / PR-xx)
- [ ] Candidate SHA and actual test commands, exit codes, environment and artifact/CI evidence provided; mandatory checks pass
- [ ] Positive, negative and applicable concurrency/recovery cases verified; no weakened tests or fabricated results
- [ ] Public contracts, migrations/rollback, security/telemetry and open decisions addressed
- [ ] Per-item checkpoint in docs/implementation/ (or linked durable record) includes remaining work and next safe step
- [ ] Independent reviewer identified; no self-approval; integration authorized and current HEAD rechecked before merge

Reviewer: record candidate SHA, verdict, findings and decisive test evidence. Integration owner updates verified checkboxes only after all gates; this template itself does not certify review or completion.
